page_title: WHU 1-2 CRY | West Ham v Crystal Palace 20/09/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+7' Niclas Fullkrug (West Ham) gives away a foul during an attacking move and the referee blows his whistle.
90+4' The game is interrupted as Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) is flagged offside.
90+3' Tony Harrington has issued a yellow card to Dean Henderson (Crystal Palace).
90+3' Luis Guilherme (West Ham) tries to get on the end of a cross in a crowded box, but under pressure his header from near the penalty spot slips well wide of the right post.
90+1' The booking goes to Jefferson Lerma (Crystal Palace).
90' We will have 7 min. of added time.
88' Justin Devenny (Crystal Palace) gets the ball and drives a shot high over the bar from the edge of the area.
85' Jefferson Lerma (Crystal Palace) has a go from a long way out but it sails way over.
83' Justin Devenny (Crystal Palace) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Tony Harrington signals.
82' Eddie Nketiah (Crystal Palace) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
82' The referee Tony Harrington awards El Hadji Malick Diouf (West Ham) a yellow card.
81' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) runs onto a good long pass and tries his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort flies high over the bar.
79' Tyrick Mitchell (Crystal Palace) got the ball on the edge of the box and fired in a first-time shot on goal, but his effort floated well over the bar. High, wide and not at all handsome.
78' Graham Potter has decided to make a change. Luis Guilherme (West Ham) replaces Crysencio Summerville.
78' Mateus Fernandes will be replaced by Soungoutou Magassa (West Ham).

76' Chance! Jefferson Lerma (Crystal Palace) gets to the rebound on the edge of the box and smashes the ball towards the bottom right corner, but Alphonse Areola is alert and makes a great save to deny him.
76' Eddie Nketiah (Crystal Palace) meets a cross just outside the area and gets in a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
76' Crysencio Summerville (West Ham) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
75' That's the end of the game for Adam Wharton, who is replaced by Eddie Nketiah (Crystal Palace).
74' Crysencio Summerville (West Ham) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
74' The foul by Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Tony Harrington.
73' Daniel Munoz (Crystal Palace) finds his way to a cross and strikes towards the goal, but one of the defending players deflects the ball away.
71' The corner from El Hadji Malick Diouf (West Ham) is hurriedly cleared.
71' Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to West Ham.
70' El Hadji Malick Diouf (West Ham) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.
68' 1 - 2 Goal! Tyrick Mitchell (Crystal Palace) fires the rebound into the roof of the net after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 1:2.
67' Kyle Walker-Peters (West Ham) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his header wasn't accurate at all and the ball went well wide of the right post.
65' Here comes a substitution. Will Hughes is given a rest as he is replaced by Jefferson Lerma (Crystal Palace).
65' Justin Devenny (Crystal Palace) pounces on a cross into the middle of the box, but plants his header well wide of the right post.
64' A neat pass is well received by Kyle Walker-Peters (West Ham), who is lurking on the edge of the box and strikes the ball on goal. The goalkeeper makes a decent save to block his shot.

64' Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) latched on to a cross inside the six-yard box and headed at goal. If it wasn't for one of the defenders making a save on the goal line, he would have been celebrating a goal now.
63' Dean Henderson (Crystal Palace) is able to continue to play.
61' Looks like Dean Henderson (Crystal Palace) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
60' The foul by Niclas Fullkrug (West Ham) was seen by Tony Harrington who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
59' The referee allows time for a substitution. Callum Wilson will be replaced by Niclas Fullkrug (West Ham).
59' Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) climbs above the defence to meet the free kick, but plants his header high over the bar from close range.
58' Crysencio Summerville (West Ham) is penalised after knocking an opponent down.
56' It looks like Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) saw red with that tackle. Tony Harrington won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
56' El Hadji Malick Diouf (West Ham) takes the corner, but the goalkeeper jumps and gathers the ball.
55' James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) launches a cross from the corner, but Dean Henderson is alert to thwart the effort.
54' A cross into the box from El Hadji Malick Diouf (West Ham) is cleared. West Ham earn a corner.
53' Daniel Munoz (Crystal Palace) receives a lofted pass from the flank and shoots from close range, but the ball flies slightly wide, almost brushing the right-hand post.
52' James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) finds some space for a shot after collecting the ball and unleashes a rocket of a shot from long distance towards the net. The goalkeeper thwarts the effort.
49' 1 - 1 Gooal! El Hadji Malick Diouf takes over corner duties. Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) gets his head on the ball from the corner and puts it into the bottom left corner. 1:1.
49' West Ham force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
49' El Hadji Malick Diouf (West Ham) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.

49' A lofted cross from Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to West Ham.
47' Maxence Lacroix (Crystal Palace) sees his header crash off the crossbar after meeting a corner kick inside the six-yard box. The goalkeeper would have been helpless.
47' Adam Wharton (Crystal Palace) prepares to take a corner kick.
46' Oliver Glasner makes a half-time substitution. Justin Devenny comes on in place of Yeremy Pino (Crystal Palace).
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+3' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+1' Today's referee Tony Harrington rightly decides to book Max Kilman (West Ham) for his harsh tackle.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
44' Daniel Munoz (Crystal Palace) connects with the corner kick around the penalty spot, but steers his header inches over the bar.
44' Adam Wharton (Crystal Palace) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
42' James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger.
41' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) heads on.
40' A yellow card for a tackle by Tyrick Mitchell (Crystal Palace). Tony Harrington doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
37' 0 - 1 Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) gets to a rebound inside the six-yard box and produces a header. He manages to put the ball into the roof of the net, and thus alter the score to 0:1.
37' CHANCE! Marc Guehi (Crystal Palace) rises high to meet the resultant corner kick and attempts to steer his fine header past the goalkeeper, but only hits the crossbar!
36' The referee signals a corner kick to Crystal Palace.
36' Yeremy Pino (Crystal Palace) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked.
35' Adam Wharton (Crystal Palace) receives a pass and fires a shot in from long range, but it's blocked.
33' Callum Wilson (West Ham) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
32' Daichi Kamada (Crystal Palace) latches on to a superb cross into the box and plants a header well wide of the right post.
32' Tony Harrington blows the whistle, Max Kilman (West Ham) is penalised for a foul.
30' El Hadji Malick Diouf (West Ham) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
27' Konstantinos Mavropanos (West Ham) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
25' Konstantinos Mavropanos (West Ham) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
25' The possession of the ball – 60:40.
22' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it.
19' El Hadji Malick Diouf (West Ham) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
18' Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Tony Harrington blows his whistle for a foul.
15' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Daichi Kamada (Crystal Palace). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
15' Tyrick Mitchell (Crystal Palace) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players. The linesman makes the right call and Crystal Palace will have a corner.
12' Tony Harrington blows his whistle after Chris Richards (Crystal Palace) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
10' Crystal Palace work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.

10' Yeremy Pino (Crystal Palace) is in the right place at the right time to receive a rebound and decides to shoot from long range, but his effort is immediately blocked. The ball is out of play and Crystal Palace manage to earn a corner.
9' The resulting corner from Daichi Kamada (Crystal Palace) is cleared by the opposition's defence.

9' Daichi Kamada (Crystal Palace) whips in a cross from the corner, but Alphonse Areola is well positioned and punches the ball away. The ball goes out of play. Crystal Palace are awarded a corner kick.
8' Daichi Kamada (Crystal Palace) takes the corner but it's cleared. Corner kick. Crystal Palace will have an opportunity.
8' Tyrick Mitchell (Crystal Palace) produces a poor pass. He attempts to get the ball into the box but it's hacked away. The referee blows his whistle, Crystal Palace are awarded a corner kick.
6' James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) attempts to find a teammate with the corner, but the effort is snuffed out by the goalkeeper.
5' The ball is cleared after Crysencio Summerville (West Ham) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. West Ham get a corner.
2' Yeremy Pino (Crystal Palace) tackles a bit over-zealously and Tony Harrington blows for a foul.
1' The match has just started.
The players are on the pitch and Crystal Palace will have the kick-off.
Tony Harrington will supervise the game today.
